title: eCommerce - Worldwide
highlights: Revenue in the eCommerce Market is projected to reach US$3.86tn in 2026.
Revenue is expected to show an annual growth rate (CAGR 2026-2030) of 6.20%, resulting in a projected market volume of US$4.91tn by 2030.
With a projected market volume of US$1.22tn in 2026, most revenue is generated United States.
In the eCommerce Market, the number of buyers is expected to amount to 4.1bn users by 2030.
Buyer penetration will be 57.1% in 2026 and is expected to hit 60.1% by 2030.
The average revenue per buyer (ARPB) is expected to amount to US$1.10k.
